fullName.value: Vitamin K epoxide reductase complex subunit 1-like protein 1

texts.value: Involved in vitamin K metabolism. Can reduce inactive vitamin K 2,3-epoxide to active vitamin K, and may contribute to vitamin K-mediated protection against oxidative stress. Plays a role in vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of Glu residues in target proteins
Inhibited by warfarin (coumadin) (PubMed:21367861, PubMed:23928358, PubMed:24532791). Warfarin locks VKORC1 in both redox states into the closed conformation (By similarity)
Up-regulated in response to oxidative stress induced by hydrogen peroxide treatment
